title: 第一卷 第3章 你这样容易被骂
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刘导摸了一把脸。

“通知后期。”

“通知什么？”

“今晚加班，把宋尔尔刚才那几句单独剪出来。”

副导演迟疑：“不是说她是炮灰吗？”

刘导盯着监视器里那张丝毫不慌的脸。

“炮灰？”

他冷笑一声。

“你见过开局把节目组炸上天的炮灰吗？”

客厅里，第一个破冰环节终于在一种诡异又好笑的气氛中结束。

主持人赶紧推进下一项流程。

“接下来，大家可以先选择房间，放好行李后，我们会进行今晚的第一次心动短信选择。”

听到“心动短信”，顾南舟下意识看了宋尔尔一眼。

宋尔尔没看他。

她只关心自己的箱子轮子有没有卡住。

姜眠走到她身边，小声说：“尔尔姐，我帮你一起拿吧？楼梯有点高。”

宋尔尔看她一眼。

小姑娘眼神有点怯，但是真的想帮忙。

宋尔尔把一个轻一点的袋子递给她：“拿这个吧，箱子重，别把你带下去。”

姜眠愣了愣，接过袋子：“好。”

她声音比刚才轻快了一点。

两人往楼梯口走。

陆执正好也过去。

宋尔尔的箱子在楼梯口磕了一下。

下一秒，一只手伸过来，握住了箱子把手。

宋尔尔抬头。

陆执站在她旁边：“我来。”

宋尔尔看着他，没松手：“陆老师，你这样容易被骂。”

陆执：“骂什么？”

宋尔尔：“骂你眼神不好。”

陆执看她两秒：“还行。”

宋尔尔：“什么还行？”

陆执接过她的箱子，语气很淡。

“眼神目前没出过大问题。”

宋尔尔眯了眯眼：“你是在夸我？”

陆执提着箱子上楼：“看你理解。”

宋尔尔跟在后面，想了想，说：“那我理解成你人还不错。”

陆执：“也行。”

弹幕又开始疯。

【不是，陆执你为什么帮她拿箱子？】

【眼神目前没出过大问题？什么意思？】

【这是什么新型夸人方式？】

【宋尔尔你别太会接。】

【我居然在倒贴姐和影帝之间闻到了一点点CP味。】

楼下，顾南舟看着两人上楼的背影，脸色沉得很快。

林栀看了他一眼，又收回视线。

主持人还在念流程。

直播镜头一路跟着宋尔尔上了二楼。

宋尔尔找到自己的房间，把行李推进去。

姜眠把袋子放在桌边，小声说：“尔尔姐，刚才谢谢你。”

宋尔尔正在检查床垫软不软，随口问：“谢我什么？”

“就是……刚才我要帮你拿箱子时候，你没有让我尴尬。”

Page (1/3)

Director Liu touched his face.

"Notice later."

"Notification of what?"

"I'll work overtime tonight and cut out the few sentences Song Er'er just said."

The assistant director hesitated: "Didn't you say she was cannon fodder?"

Director Liu stared at the unfazed face in the monitor.

"Cannon fodder?"

He sneered.

"Have you ever seen the cannon fodder that blew up the show crew at the beginning?"

In the living room, the first ice-breaking session finally ended in a weird and funny atmosphere.

The host quickly moved on to the next process.

"Next, everyone can choose the room first. After putting away the luggage, we will make the first heartbeat text message selection tonight."

After hearing the "heartbeat text message", Gu Nanzhou glanced at Song Er'er subconsciously.

Song Er'er didn't look at him.

All she cared about was whether the wheels of her box were stuck.

Jiang Mian walked to her side and whispered: "Sister Er'er, can I help you get it? The stairs are a bit high."

Song Erer glanced at her.

The little girl looked a little timid, but she really wanted to help.

Song Er'er handed her a lighter bag: "Take this, the box is heavy, don't take you down."

Jiang Mian was stunned for a moment, then took the bag: "Okay."

Her voice was a little lighter than before.

The two of them walked towards the stairs.

Lu Zhi happened to pass by as well.

Song Er'er's box knocked against the stairs.

The next second, a hand reached out and grasped the handle of the box.

Song Er'er looked up.

Lu Zhi stood next to her: "I'll do it."

Song Er'er looked at him and didn't let go: "Teacher Lu, you are easily scolded."

Lu Zhi: "What are you scolding?"

Song Er'er: "I scolded you for having bad eyesight."

Lu Zhi looked at her for two seconds: "It's okay."

Song Er'er: "What's okay?"

Lu Zhi took the box from her with a very calm tone.

"There's no big problem with my eyes so far."

Song Er'er narrowed his eyes: "Are you praising me?"

Lu Zhi carried the box upstairs and said, "I hope you understand."

Song Er'er followed, thought for a moment, and said, "Then I understand that you are a pretty good person."

Lu Zhi: "Alright."

The barrage started going crazy again.

[No, Lu Zhi, why did you help her get the box?】

[You haven’t had any major problems with your eyes so far?What's the meaning?】

[What kind of new way of praising someone is this?】

[Song Er'er, don't be too good at answering.】

[I actually smelled a little bit of CP between the cheating sister and the actor.】

Downstairs, Gu Nanzhou's face darkened quickly as he watched the two people walking upstairs.

Lin Zhi glanced at him and then looked away.

The host is still reading the process.

The live camera followed Song Er'er all the way to the second floor.

Song Er'er found his room and pushed his luggage in.

Jiang Mian put the bag on the table and whispered, "Sister Er'er, thank you just now."

Song Er'er was checking whether the mattress was soft and asked casually: "Why are you thanking me?"

"It's just... you didn't embarrass me when I was helping you pick up the box."
